newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Securities says revises up 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Securities says revises up 1997 net.

text.p: Indonesian PT Lippo Securities said on Friday it has revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 95.7 billion rupiah from the previous of 87.0 billion rupiah.
The brokerage firm posted a net profit of 45.7 billion rupiah in 1996.

"We have revised our 1997 net income projection up to 95.7 billion rupiah, representing an increase of 109 percent over the 45.7 billion rupiah recorded in 1996," Lippo Securities said in a statement.
"We expect to announce further upward earnings revisions later this year," the statement said.
The statement said Lippo Securities had diversified its revenue streams to include corporate finance fees, proprietary trading and interest income.

"In 1997, we expect brokerage commissions to account for 24 percent of our gross operating revenues while corporate finance fees will probably account for more than 35 percent of our operating revenue base," it said.
Brokerage commissions accounted for 27 percent of Lippo Securities's gross operating revenues in 1996. The statement did not give further figures.
The statement said Lippo Securities's 43.5 percent subsidiary insurance firm Lippo Life was expected to achieve a net profit of 131 billion rupiah in 1997 against 66 billion rupiah in 1996.
Lippo Life has a controlling stake in large-sized Lippo Bank.
